_comment: Choreography cues for Abraham and Isaac, Revisited (PAM roadmap, Milestone 5).
A cue is a list of PAM steps, compiled in place of the screenplay element whose [[beat: id]] note names it; 'scenes' holds what each scene file starts and ends with.
The steps are the hand-authored blocking of Milestone 4, moved here unchanged from the scene files, which fountain2pam.py --project now writes.

s01_takes_quill.note: Anticipation: a still opening (the shot establishes him on his rock).  Action: his hand goes to the satchel.  Reaction: the quill comes out in it.  Recovery: a flourish of the quill.

s01_writes.note: Anticipation: a flourish.  Action: the line is written while the quill hand moves along it (tic scribble_r).  Reaction: a nod.  Recovery: he lifts the quill off the page and admires it (so that nothing covers the line in the insert).

s01_insert.note: Long enough to read the line (about two seconds).

s01_question_mark.note: On the insert (the screenplay's second INSERT - THE SCROLL): the quill comes down to the period (anticipation), turns it into a question mark (action), and lifts away so that the audience has time to read KNIFE? (reaction).

s01_thud.note: Anticipation: a pleased nod at the question mark.  Action: THUD! (a word on screen, from the cave, to his right), and he jumps where he sits.  Reaction: he stares toward the cave.  Recovery: the quill into the satchel, the scroll rolled up into his belt, and he looks toward the cave again.

s02_checks_clips.note: Isaac lifts the barbell overhead, sets it down (THUD! — the noise Abraham heard in Scene 1), takes out his phone and strolls to his spot by the magazines, watching it.

s02_abraham_enters.note: He walks in from off stage left, past the rope by the entrance.

steps.text: What are you sacrificing me with?

s02_draws_knife.note: The first steps of the Stage 4a sequence s02_knife.  Milestone 6: his hand goes to the satchel (pose reach_satchel) and comes out holding the knife by the blade, then holds it out to Isaac (offer_r), handle first.

s02_knife_breaks.note: The timed block s02_break of the Stage 4a sequence s02_knife, with two cuts added in Milestone 5: to the bowl on frame 6, as the blade falls (it lands on frame 9), and to the wide shot on frame 18, where Isaac speaks.  They stand for the CAMERA notes before the next two elements.

s02_blade_in_bowl.note: The blade falls into the bowl inside s02_break (cue s02_knife_breaks), so nothing is compiled here.

s02_short_ceremony.note: Isaac says this line on frame 18 of s02_break (cue s02_knife_breaks), so nothing is compiled here.

s02_handle_down.note: Isaac puts the handle in the bowl (a Stage 4a blocking choice) looking at the blade, then looks at the magazine on the stack to his left, then at his phone.

s02_into_satchel.note: Isaac picks up the barbell, tucks it under his arm and strides out past his father; meanwhile Abraham gathers the two pieces of the knife from the bowl and drops them into his satchel (the Stage 4a steps, unchanged).

s02_slings_rope.note: He walks back to the entrance, stoops for the coil and slings it over his shoulder.

s02_pockets_phone.note: Isaac pockets the phone as he leaves (a Stage 4a blocking choice; he is off stage by now), and Abraham hurries after him.

s03_climb.note: Isaac strides in at an even pace with the barbell on his shoulders and stops to look back; Abraham staggers in after him in short walks, hunched over between them.

s04_props_phone.note: Isaac walks to the little rock, crouches, and props his phone upright on it, its camera toward the altar (the Stage 4a step).

s04_takes_pieces_out.note: His hand into the satchel; the two pieces out (the Stage 4a step); he looks at them.

s04_blade_into_satchel.note: The blade back into the satchel (the Stage 4a step); he keeps the handle.

s04_winds_rope.note: tie_wrist_loop: he takes the coil from his shoulder as he steps up (anticipation), winds it round Isaac's wrists in loops that get bigger and wilder (action; the rope goes from his shoulder to the wrists, state 'tied', on the same frames), fiddles with the knot (reaction) and lets go (recovery).  The handle stays in his other hand throughout.

s04_yanks_knot.note: tie_wrist_loop, its knot and yank: his hands go to the knot (anticipation) and yank it tight, three frames (action; the rope 'tightened' on the same frames), and he lets go.  Isaac tugs at it: it holds; a shrug, and he lies back on the altar, propped on his elbows.

s04_picks_up_phone.note: He walks to the rock, picks up the phone (the Stage 4a step) and comes back with it.  He holds it out (pose reach_side_l, added in Milestone 5), so that the knife handle in his other hand does not cover the LIVE button in the insert.

s05_blade.note: The blade sticks point-first in the altar's log (the barbell's log, since the barbell became the altar), inches from Isaac's arm.

s01_studies.note: He cannot frown, so he peers and shakes his head; the reaction is a still, doubtful hold before the cut to the insert.

do.text: Dad! What about knocking? What if I was changing?
I've been working on the Torah.
Can it wait? I have a match to study.
He says I have to sacrifice a son.

s02_looks_up.note: A beat; the phone comes down and his head comes up; he stares.

do.text: Hagar said if I sacrifice Ishmael, I have to sleep outside.

s02_magazine.note: The phone goes into his pocket (it comes out again when it buzzes); his right hand takes the top magazine from the stack beside him and holds it up by his head.

do.text: "Sacrificial lamb" doesn't fit my online persona.

s02_persona.note: He keeps the cover up through both sentences, then puts it back on the stack.

do.text: I know. But it's the word of God.

s02_counts.note: He raises his hand to count on.

do.text: Say a few words to teach Israel a lesson.

s02_the_list.note: Five items, five taps of a finger on the raised hand (tic count_tap_r); nothing on 'And then...'.

s02_out_of_fingers.note: A beat with the finger still raised, then he brings the hand up to his face and stares at it.

s02_buzz.note: BZZZ at his hip and a little jump; the phone comes out; he reads.

do.text: My manager wants me to wrestle Friday. Can you drive me to Ocean City?

s02_come_on.note: A thumb over his shoulder toward the way out on 'Come on.'

s02_pull.note: Anticipation: he squares up to Isaac.  Action: pull_immovable (the action phase is shared by its reach, pull and strain, 6:12:12); Isaac does not move.  Reaction: slip_on_back, the fall.  Recovery: the comic hold, flat on his back; Isaac looks down at him.

s02_cork_and_hug.note: cork_pop_up: Isaac offers his hand and Abraham takes it (anticipation), the pop (action, 3 frames), the landing and the image held before anyone speaks (reaction).  mismatched_hug: he steps in (anticipation), throws his arms around Isaac's middle (action), squeezes (reaction), and holds on, his arms short of halfway (recovery).  He is still holding on for the next line.

do.text: Have you thought about a diet?

s02_diet.note: Said into Isaac's side, still in the hug.  Then he lets go and steps back to where he can show the knife.

s04_builds_altar.note: Isaac drops the barbell (THUD!, and Abraham, still blown from the climb, jumps), steps to its end and takes it apart into the altar beside him: the boulders set apart, the log laid across them (barbell state 'altar').  The left boulder is crooked; Abraham straightens it, Isaac comes round and nudges it back with his foot, and they agree with a shrug and a nod.

do.text: We go up the mountain. I build the altar.
You raise what's left of that knife and tell
everybody God doesn't want people sacrificing people.

s03_the_plan.note: Isaac lays out the plan, looking back at his father, and strolls on; Abraham plods after him, stopping hunched over.

s03_catch_breath.note: Abraham bent over, hands on his knees, heaving; Isaac stands and waits, perfectly still.

s03_morality.note: Gasped from where he is bent over; then he straightens up.

do.text: "Sacrifice a Lamb for God." It'll be huge on TikTok.

s03_challenge.note: Both hands up and apart: the headline in lights.

s03_bounds_over_rock.note: Isaac walks up to the rock, crouches, and bounds over it in one easy leap, landing beyond it; he strolls on and turns to watch.  Abraham trudges up to the rock.

s03_climbs_rock.note: Hands on the rock, he hauls himself up, slides back, hauls again, and crawls along the top on his hands and knees.

do.text: You sure you're up for this, Dad?
I am the father of nations.

s03_father_of_nations.note: He rises up on his knees on the rock to say it, a hand on his chest, then crawls on.

s03_catch.note: catch_by_collar: he stands up on the rock (anticipation), his sandal slips and Isaac catches him by the collar (action: the slip and the catch), he kicks in the air and goes limp (reaction: the dangle), and hangs there (recovery).  Isaac's other hand stays on the barbell.  The hold lasts until s03_sets_down.

s03_lamb.note: Isaac looks about him; his father still hanging from his fist.

do.text: I thought you brought the lamb.

s03_brought_altar.note: The barbell bounces on his shoulders.

s03_provide.note: A finger up to heaven, still hanging.

s03_sets_down.note: catch_by_collar again, with only its set_down phase: Isaac sets him on his feet and lets go.  Abraham gives himself a shake; Isaac walks on, and Abraham staggers after him.

s04_heroic_pose.note: For the screen: Isaac, fists on hips, chin up; Abraham tries it, and gets one fist on a hip and the other hand over his eyes.  The image is held.

do.text: Remember: raise the handle, not the blade.

s04_sits_on_altar.note: Isaac sits back on the log of the altar, facing his father, and holds out his wrists.

do.text: I'm supposed to escape after the speech.

s04_bow.note: Said fiddling with the knot (tie_wrist_loop, only its knot).

do.text: Give it here, I'll tie myself up.
I was tying knots before you were born.

s04_before_you_were_born.note: Chin up, a hand on his chest, as on the rock in Scene 3.

do.text: Press the red button when you're ready.

s04_press_red.note: Both tied hands point at the phone; then he lies back again.

s04_rehearses.note: A nod; he counts silently on his fingers, the phone in one hand and the handle in the other; his hands shake.  He turns and goes to lean the phone back against its rock (he gets there in Scene 5).
